description: Has-extension request whose original file is missing falls into rewrite resolution. Rewrite `/missing.html → /index.html`; only /index.html exists. Request `GET /missing.html` triggers pre-stat (per phase-7 asymmetry per openspec/specs/rewrites/spec.md:24-26), pre-stat fails, rewrite is then consulted, rewritten path /index.html resolves, body of /index.html is served. Mirrors `findRelated`'s `rewrittenPath ? [rewrittenPath] : getPossiblePaths(...)` branch at serve-handler/src/index.js:618-632 — when a rewrite matches, the rewritten path is the only candidate tried, NOT cleanUrls candidates of the original path. cleanUrls disabled in fixture so we don't get distracted by phase-4 redirects.
